final: SELECT team_id, AVG(CAST(w AS FLOAT) / CAST(g AS FLOAT)) as avg_win_rate, COUNT(*) as record_count, AVG(CAST(w AS FLOAT) / CAST(g AS FLOAT)) - (SELECT AVG(team_avg) FROM (SELECT AVG(CAST(w AS FLOAT) / CAST(g AS FLOAT)) as team_avg FROM manager_half WHERE w IS NOT NULL AND g IS NOT NULL AND g > 0 GROUP BY team_id)) as difference_from_mean FROM manager_half WHERE w IS NOT NULL AND g IS NOT NULL AND g > 0 GROUP BY team_id ORDER BY difference_from_mean DESC LIMIT 10
